description: Nutrition and training app company run by Stronger By Science Technologies LLC (headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina). Its two apps, MacroFactor Nutrition (adaptive macro/calorie tracking and nutrition coaching) and MacroFactor Workouts (personalized training programming), together serve more than 600,000 users, per the brand's own partnership page.

evidence.summary: MacroFactor's official partnership page offers affiliate partnerships: partners receive a unique code giving their audience an extended free trial and earn commission when referred users become paying subscribers. The standard affiliate commission is stated verbatim as 40% of the user's first subscription payment, with worked examples ($4.80 monthly, $19.20 six-month, $28.80 yearly, $36 yearly bundle). No earnings-cap statement appears on the page, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

The page says MacroFactor works with a select group of creators, educators, athletes and media partners in fitness, nutrition, training and health; it lists content formats it wants (YouTube integrations and Shorts, Instagram Reels/posts/Stories, TikTok posts, podcast and newsletter sponsorships), names eight creators it has partnered with (including Jesse James West, Will Tennyson and Lean Beef Patty), offers paid sponsorships alongside the affiliate option, and links an open partnership application form. 'Select group' is a relative claim with no creator count, so saturation is recorded as unknown.
Madeometer's company profile states MacroFactor is headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, and is managed by Stronger By Science Technologies LLC; the app launched in September 2021.

name: MacroFactor

opportunity.title: MacroFactor Partnership Program (affiliate partnerships and paid sponsorships)

reasons.compensation: A published, high rate on the brand's own page: 40% of the referred user's first subscription payment, with dollar examples for each plan tier.
reasons.contact_access: A public partnership application form on the official page plus a published support email — near the top band, though no dedicated partnerships inbox is published.
reasons.credibility: Established app business (Stronger By Science Technologies LLC, Raleigh NC) reporting more than 600,000 users across its two apps on its own page.
reasons.niche_fit: Nutrition coaching and workout apps built for fitness/nutrition creators — squarely in the wellness UGC niche, with the brand explicitly recruiting fitness, nutrition, training and health creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The application form is publicly open on the partnership page to creators, educators, athletes and media partners.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The official page names eight creators it has partnered with, lists the exact content formats it buys (YouTube integrations/Shorts, Reels, TikTok, podcasts, newsletters) and offers both affiliate and paid-sponsorship tracks.

description: Personalized vitamin pack subscription service (Vitamin Packs Inc. dba Persona Nutrition, based at 35131 SE Douglas St, Unit 110, Snoqualmie, WA 98065). Customers take an online assessment and receive dietitian-guided daily vitamin packs tailored to their diet, lifestyle and medication interactions, delivered by subscription.

evidence.summary: Persona's official Affiliate Partner page ('JOIN THE PACK') invites influencers to join its influencer community and introduce personalized vitamin packs to their audience, with a 'Get Started with Persona' application route. The page publishes no commission rate, so no rate could be verified from the brand itself.

Third-party sources conflict on Persona's affiliate pay, so commission_rate is null: TheAffiliatesList reports a $25 flat bounty per qualified subscription on a Direct/Impact program with a 30-day cookie, while InfluencerMarketingHub (influencermarketinghub.com/supplement-affiliate-programs/) and BrandAndPartners (brandandpartners.com/supplement-affiliate-programs/) both report 25% per sale. The network is recorded as Impact per TheAffiliatesList.

The official page publishes Persona's contact details: info@personanutrition.com, phone 1-800-983-3887, and the address 35131 SE Douglas St, Unit 110, Snoqualmie WA 98065. Note: Persona's separate customer Refer-a-Friend scheme pays $20 in store credit (capped at $200/month) per its refer-a-friend terms — that store-credit scheme is NOT the basis of this entry; the entry rests on the influencer/affiliate program above.

name: Persona Nutrition

opportunity.title: Persona Affiliate Partner Program ("Join the Pack" influencer community)

reasons.compensation: Third-party listings agree a paid affiliate program exists but conflict on the pay itself ($25 flat per subscription vs 25% per sale), and the brand publishes no rate — so the rate is recorded as null and compensation scores mid-low.
reasons.contact_access: A public affiliate application page on the official site plus a published general email and phone number — top band per the rubric.
reasons.credibility: Established subscription brand (Vitamin Packs Inc., Snoqualmie WA) covered by Forbes, ABC News, The Oprah Magazine and Health/Shape per BrandAndPartners' profile.
reasons.niche_fit: Personalized daily vitamin packs are a core wellness-creator product, and the program page is written directly for wellness influencers.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The 'Get Started with Persona' route on the official affiliate page is publicly open to influencers.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An official influencer community ('Join the Pack') with an application route exists on the brand's own site, though no named creator partners or content deliverables are published.

description: Consumer genomics and personalized health platform founded in 2016 and based in Miami, Florida (CB Insights). SelfDecode turns DNA data and lab results into personalized health reports and recommendations using polygenic risk scores and AI, sold as DNA kits, health analysis plans and add-on reports by subscription.

evidence.summary: SelfDecode's official affiliate program page ('Health Affiliate Program - Earn 25% Commission') describes a tiered affiliate system with a 90-day cookie, monthly payouts via PayPal or bank transfer, a marketing kit and a dedicated affiliate support team. It explicitly recruits biohackers, content creators focused on health/wellness/genetics, health coaches and fitness, nutrition and mental-health influencers. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

SelfDecode's official referral page states that affiliate commissions start at 10%, with potential for increased earnings based on performance — consistent with the affiliate page's 'up to 25%' headline and tier system, so the rate is recorded as a 10-25% range. (The same page's separate friends-and-family scheme pays a $50 Amazon gift card per referred subscription; that is not the affiliate commission.)

Lasso's affiliate directory lists the SelfDecode affiliate program at up to 25% commission with a 90-day cookie, a $50 payout threshold, and joining via the Impact affiliate platform with manual approval for applicants with a relevant health/nutrition/genetics audience.
CB Insights profiles SelfDecode as founded in 2016 and headquartered in Miami, Florida, providing health insights through DNA analysis, including genetic risk assessments and an AI health coach.

name: SelfDecode

reasons.compensation: Published tiered pay on the brand's own pages: commissions start at 10% and rise to 25% with performance, on a 90-day cookie.
reasons.contact_access: A public program page with a detailed FAQ and a stated affiliate support team, but no published partnerships email — upper-mid band.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2016 with a 4.7/5 rating across 750 reviews cited on its own program pages; a mid-size specialist rather than a mass-market brand.
reasons.niche_fit: DNA-based personalized health reports are a strong fit for health, biohacking and wellness creators, whom the program page names directly.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The affiliate program is publicly documented on the brand's own site with joining routed through Impact and manual approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own program page is written for content creators and influencers and provides a marketing kit and affiliate support, though no named creator partners are published.

description: Maine-based mushroom cultivation company launched in 2014 by a mycologist, an organic farmer and a photojournalist. North Spore sells ready-to-fruit mushroom grow kits, grain/sawdust/plug spawn, substrates and cultivation tools and equipment for growing gourmet and medicinal mushrooms at home or commercially, alongside educational mycology content.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory lists North Spore's affiliate program on the Impact platform at 10% commission per sale, described as the rate officially listed with the program (page last updated March 11, 2024), with joining routed through Impact. No cap or creator-count data is published, so cap and saturation are recorded as unknown.

Sovrn Commerce's merchant profile describes North Spore as a Maine-based mushroom cultivation company founded in 2014 by three friends with backgrounds in mycology, biology and the arts, selling grow kits, spawn, substrates and indoor/outdoor cultivation equipment.

North Spore's official site publishes a partnership route for organizations (an exclusive 10% member discount code program for mushroom, foraging, outdoor and education organizations) with applications directed to jill@northspore.com — evidence the brand runs partner programs and publishes a contact for them.

name: North Spore

reasons.compensation: A published network rate exists — 10% per sale on Impact per the network directory — a mid-range rate for the category.
reasons.contact_access: A published partnerships contact email on the official site (for organization programs), but the affiliate route itself is only via the Impact marketplace — mid band.
reasons.credibility: Specialist category leader operating since 2014 with a full cultivation-supply catalog and educational resources.
reasons.niche_fit: Mushroom grow kits and cultivation supplies sit in the food/gardening creator niche — grow-along and harvest content is highly visual, though narrower than mainstream food brands.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Creators join by applying to the program inside Impact; there is no brand-hosted application page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand is built around educational mycology content and runs partner programs, but no creator-specific program page or named creator partners were found.

description: UK plant-based nutrition brand selling nutrient-dense vegan supplements and fitness nutrition, including the Perform plant-based protein line, through its own UK/US web stores. Its affiliate programme recruits promoters across social media, blogs and podcasts to spread the word about plant-based health products.

evidence.summary: Vivo Life's official Social Snowball affiliate terms page publishes the program terms: base commission 10.00%, commission type percent of sale, 30-day cookie, conversion on online purchase with processed valid payment. It invites applicants to complete the form on the page to earn commission from a personal link, describing a worldwide network of promoters using social media, online content, blogs and podcasts. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is recorded as unknown; 'worldwide network' is a relative claim, so saturation is unknown.

LinkMyDeals' network roundup shows Vivo Life also runs campaigns on Awin (including a Vivo Life UK merchant listing), corroborating an active multi-channel affiliate operation alongside the brand's own Social Snowball programme, whose published 10% base rate governs this entry.

name: Vivo Life

reasons.compensation: Published pay in the brand's own terms: 10% base commission on the percent-of-sale program with a 30-day cookie.
reasons.contact_access: An application form on the official programme page itself; no separate partnerships email is published — upper-mid band.
reasons.credibility: Established UK plant-based nutrition brand with international web stores and an additional Awin network presence.
reasons.niche_fit: Plant-based protein and supplements for fitness and wellness audiences — a proven creator niche, with the programme explicitly aimed at social, blog and podcast promoters.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open via the form on the brand's own programme page (approval at the brand's discretion).
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal affiliate programme with published terms on the brand's own site and promotion rules written for social media creators, though no named creator partners are published.

description: Women's health company based in Bellingham, Washington, making science-based fertility, pregnancy, nursing and broader women's health products since 2003 — including the FertilAid and FH PRO supplement lines, the OvaCue fertility monitor and BabyDance fertility lubricant — sold through its own site and healthcare providers.

evidence.summary: Lasso's affiliate directory lists the Fairhaven Health affiliate program at 15% commission per sale with a 30-day cookie and a $50 payout threshold, with joining routed through ShareASale. No cap or creator-count data is published, so cap and saturation are recorded as unknown.

Affilorama's 2026 fertility-program comparison independently lists Fairhaven Health at 15% commission on the full cart, 30-day cookie, via ShareASale. An older directory (affiliateprograms.com) describes a 10-20% range with the OvaCue fertility monitor at 10%; the standard 15% rate is corroborated by both current sources and is the rate recorded.

CB Insights profiles Fairhaven Health as based in Bellingham, Washington, offering supplements and tools for fertility enhancement, prenatal care, postnatal nursing and vaginal health; the brand dates to 2003 and is now part of Blueroot Health per its 2025 GlobeNewswire release.

name: Fairhaven Health

reasons.compensation: Published pay: 15% per sale on the full cart (30-day cookie) per two independent current directories — a solid rate for the niche.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email or brand-hosted application page was found; joining is handled inside ShareASale — lower band.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2003, ISO-13485 certified, with products recommended by healthcare practitioners and sold through clinics.
reasons.niche_fit: Fertility, pregnancy and nursing products map directly onto the large TTC and women's-health creator community.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Creators apply through the ShareASale marketplace listing rather than an open brand page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-running affiliate program marketed to women's-health bloggers and influencers, but no brand-run creator community or named creator partners were found.

description: Leading mental health app offering guided meditation, sleep content and tools for stress, anxiety and processing thoughts, sold by subscription to consumers and through more than 4,000 employer organizations worldwide.

evidence.summary: WhichProgram's directory entry (collected September 11, 2026) records Headspace's program on impact.com and quotes the network's own statement: 3-8% commission on order value for subscriptions — 8% for annual subscriptions, 5% for monthly subscriptions, 3% for gift subscriptions — with a 45-day click attribution window, recurring commissions, US conversions only, and application required.

Other sources conflict with the network statement, so commission_rate is null: GeekChamp reports approximately 15% per subscription via Impact, Uppromote (uppromote.com/affiliate-directory/headspace/) reports 20% of first-year subscription revenue, and UmaTechnology reports up to $15 per new subscriber. The tiered 3-8% network statement is the most detailed source, but the conflict prevents recording a single rate.

Uppromote's directory entry records the program's accepted traffic sources as including content/blogs, review sites, search and sub-affiliate/influencer networks, and notes Headspace partners with over 4,000 organizations worldwide — evidence the program is open to influencer-type promoters, not only coupon sites.

name: Headspace

reasons.compensation: Real published network terms exist (a tiered 3-8% of subscription order value, recurring), but third-party sources conflict (15%, 20%, $15 CPA), so the rate is recorded as null and compensation scores conservatively.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email or brand-hosted application was found; everything runs through Impact — lower band.
reasons.credibility: One of the world's largest mental-health apps, partnering with 4,000+ organizations, with a long-established subscription business.
reasons.niche_fit: Meditation, sleep and mental-health content is a core wellness-creator niche and Headspace is its best-known consumer brand.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application is required through the Impact marketplace; acceptance is at the brand's discretion.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The Impact program accepts influencer/sub-affiliate traffic per directory listings, but Headspace publishes no creator program page or named creator partners.

description: New York-based femtech company that created the reusable period and incontinence underwear category, selling Thinx period underwear, Thinx (BTWN) for teens, Speax by Thinx and Thinx for All through its own site and mass retailers. Kimberly-Clark acquired a majority stake in February 2022.

evidence.summary: Thinx's affiliate program application is live on the Ascend (Partnerize) partner platform: the registration page asks applicants whether they are an individual who will promote brands on their personal social media or personal blog, confirming the program is open to individual creators, not only coupon/paid-search businesses.

Lasso's affiliate directory confirms a Thinx affiliate program in the women's health category but lists both the commission rate and cookie duration as unknown — Thinx does not publish its affiliate pay, so commission_rate is null. No cap or creator-count data is published, so cap and saturation are unknown.

Wikipedia profiles Thinx as a New York City-headquartered company selling period underwear, with Kimberly-Clark holding a majority stake since 2022. Note: Thinx also runs a separate customer referral scheme ($10 account credit per referral per RetailMeNot) — that store-credit scheme is not the basis of this entry; the entry rests on the Partnerize affiliate program above.

name: Thinx

reasons.compensation: No published pay data: directories list the rate as unknown and the brand publishes no terms — at the no-data cap per the rubric.
reasons.contact_access: A live public application form on the Partnerize/Ascend platform, though no published partnerships email — mid band.
reasons.credibility: Category creator with national mass-retail distribution (Target, Walmart) and majority ownership by Kimberly-Clark since 2022.
reasons.niche_fit: Period care is a large, content-rich women's-health niche and Thinx is its category-defining brand.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The application is publicly accessible and explicitly open to individual social-media promoters.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program's own application explicitly recruits individuals promoting on personal social media and blogs, but no creator community, named partners or published content terms were found.

reasons.credibility: A smaller DTC coffee brand; credible sustainability partnerships (One Tree Planted) but limited public company footprint compared with national brands.
reasons.niche_fit: Cold brew coffee concentrate is a natural fit for food, coffee and morning-routine creators, with an easy at-home preparation story.

description: Dentist-founded oral care brand from Galway, Ireland, founded in 2016 by dentists Dr Lisa Creaven, Dr Vanessa Creaven and Dr Barry Buckley. Spotlight sells clinically proven, vegan and cruelty-free toothpastes, teeth whitening products, sonic toothbrushes and water flossers online and through retailers including Boots, Tesco and Dunnes Stores.

evidence.summary: Spotlight Oral Care's official affiliate page gives step-by-step joining instructions for its Awin programme (programme number 25720, with a brand-supplied Awin verification code), states that affiliates who sign up this month earn 6% per sale, paid monthly with no minimum threshold, and names francesca@spotlightoralcare.com as the support contact. The page also notes Awin lets affiliates sign up using their Instagram data. 'No minimum threshold' is a payout-threshold term, not an earnings cap, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Spotlight Oral Care's Awin merchant profile confirms the commission structure: 6% standard commission, 10% cashback, 2% on voucher codes, 0% for gift vouchers, with average order value over £45. (Lasso's directory instead claims 10% via Refersion; the brand's own current Awin terms govern this entry.)

BeautyMatter profiles Spotlight Oral Care as based in Galway, Ireland, founded in 2016 by Dr Lisa Creaven, Dr Vanessa Creaven and Dr Barry Buckley to build a clean, high-performance oral care brand; the brand has raised growth capital from Development Capital and sells through blue-chip retailers in Ireland, the UK, Europe and the US.

name: Spotlight Oral Care

reasons.compensation: Published pay on the brand's own page and network profile: 6% standard commission per sale (10% cashback tier), paid monthly with no minimum payout threshold.
reasons.contact_access: A public affiliate page with full joining instructions plus a named affiliate support email (francesca@spotlightoralcare.com) — top band per the rubric.
reasons.credibility: Dentist-founded 2016 brand headquartered in Galway with national retail distribution (Boots, Tesco, Dunnes) and institutional growth investment.
reasons.niche_fit: Oral care and teeth whitening sit at the health/beauty crossover that performs strongly in creator content, though the niche is narrower than skincare or supplements.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Signup is publicly open via Awin with a brand-supplied verification code that skips the bank-details step.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal affiliate programme with an influencer-friendly signup path (Awin registration using Instagram data) documented on the brand's own page, though no named creator partners are published.
